subject: An office that closes away
hook: A home office that disappears at five
gbp:
Bespoke home office furniture, including desks that close away behind doors.

If you work from home in Congleton or around Stoke-on-Trent but do not have a spare room to give up, a fitted office cupboard lets you work in the living room, dining room or a bedroom alcove and shut it all away at the end of the day.

What is included:
- A free, no-obligation design consultation, planned around your screen, printer and paperwork
- A full measure and an itemised quote with no hidden costs
- Desk, shelving and storage built and assembled in our own workshop in Hanley
- Cable routes and grommets planned in, so you can close the doors without unplugging
- Installation by our own team

Soft-close as standard, in matt, wood-effect, painted and other finishes to match the room it sits in.

Book a free consultation to plan your workspace.
